museum pass is valid. The Terrace Houses need a separate ticket. Local tip: on the way back, drive up to the village of
and wander among its stone houses. In the evening, eat
. Did you know? The Library of Celsus is thought to have held more than twelve thousand scrolls. Your next stop is the Temple of Artemis, about four kilometres by car, around ten minutes.
